recognize_zh: 肝臟竇狀隙內的浸潤細胞大多 CD34 陰性，只見零星幾顆 CD34 陽性的母細胞，右下血管內皮為內部陽性對照；說明 JMML 浸潤以成熟中的骨髓單核系細胞為主、母細胞並未增加到急性白血病程度。
features: Liver parenchyma with hepatocyte plates and infiltrated sinusoids
Only rare scattered CD34-positive mononuclear cells (strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining)
Majority of infiltrating sinusoidal cells are CD34-negative
CD34-positive endothelium of a vessel at lower right (internal positive control)
No clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD34 on a liver section shows hepatocyte plates with sinusoids containing an infiltrate of hematopoietic cells. Only rare scattered infiltrating cells are CD34-positive, and the vast majority of sinusoidal cells are negative; endothelium of a vessel serves as an internal positive control. There are no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts. Findings indicate that blasts are not increased within the hepatic infiltrate, supporting involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia rather than transformation to acute leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia / myeloid sarcoma involving liver
ddx.vs: Would show numerous or sheet-like CD34+ (or CD117+) blasts, whereas CD34+ cells here are rare.
Also has few CD34+ cells; distinguished by megakaryocytes/erythroid islands without monocytic predominance and by clinical setting.
Shows many circulating/hepatic megakaryoblasts that are often CD34+/CD41+/CD61+, with GATA1 mutation.
